author: Gordian Edenhofer, Catherine Zucker, Philipp Frank, Andrew K. Saydjari, Joshua S. Speagle, Douglas Finkbeiner & Torsten Ensslin
note: Direct conversion of Edenhofer et al.'s three-dimensional extinction-density reconstruction around the Sun. The 1,072-pc-wide local window lies within the Local/Orion Arm and approximately matches this item's 3,500-light-year width. It is not a measurement of the arm's full width, length or boundary. Each point is a 16-pc-spaced sample of the published Cartesian mean grid; the densest 5% of finite samples reveal nearby cloud structure. Colors encode log extinction density, not emitted light, and omitted low-density or unavailable samples are not empty space. No invented clouds, stars, depth or arm shape.

operations: Direct conversion of hash-pinned public catalog coordinates; physical units retained.
Native units: pc; 15707 distinct source records.
One soft point per selected record; no generated geometry, rulers, random depths or filler stars.
